metadata.question: Does Jabal Qidr have a darker color than Jabal Bayda, as observed in April 2024?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: We will use the Sentinel-2 MSI collection (2024-04-01 – 2024-04-30) over the two volcanic cones in Harrat Khaybar (Saudi Arabia). - Jabal Qidr ( darker lava cone ) ≈ 25.07 °N, 39.92 °E - Jabal Bayda ( white-colored cone ) ≈ 25.14 °N, 39.95 °E 2. Masking strategy: cloud + cirrus masks, then keep april scenes only. We want the surface reflectance, so we use COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED and apply the QA60 band mask. 3. Logic: - Compute the median true-color composite (B4, B3, B2) for each cone during April 2024. - Use B4 (red, 10 m) as the proxy for “darkness” (lower reflectance = darker). - Sample a 300-m radius around each summit. - If no images, C1; if after masking we have 0 valid pixels inside either ROI, C2; if mean is None/NaN, C3; otherwise compare means: if Qidr < Bayda → A (Yes), else B (No). ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & dates roi_q = ee.Geometry.Point(39.92, 25.07).buffer(300) # Jabal Qidr roi_b = ee.Geometry.Point(39.95, 25.14).buffer(300) # Jabal Bayda april24 = ee.DateRange('2024-04-01', '2024-04-30') # 2. Data acquisition s2 = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(roi_q).filterBounds(roi_b) .filterDate(april24) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 40)) .map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('QA60').eq(0)))) n = s2.size().getInfo() if n == 0: print("No April 2024 images.") print("C1") else: # 3. Processing med = s2.median() red_q = med.select('B4').reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=roi_q, scale=10, maxPixels=1e9).get('B4') red_b = med.select('B4').reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=roi_b, scale=10, maxPixels=1e9).get('B4') val_q = red_q.getInfo() val_b = red_b.getInfo() if val_q is None or val_b is None: print("Calculation returned None.") print("C3") else: print(f"April 2024 images: {n}") print(f"Jabal Qidr B4 mean: {val_q:.3f}") print(f"Jabal Bayda B4 mean: {val_b:.3f}") print("A" if val_q < val_b else "B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & dates
roi_q = ee.Geometry.Point(39.92, 25.07).buffer(300)   # Jabal Qidr
roi_b = ee.Geometry.Point(39.95, 25.14).buffer(300)   # Jabal Bayda
april24 = ee.DateRange('2024-04-01', '2024-04-30')

# 2. Data acquisition
s2 = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
        .filterBounds(roi_q).filterBounds(roi_b)
        .filterDate(april24)
        .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 40))
        .map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('QA60').eq(0))))

n = s2.size().getInfo()
if n == 0:
    print("No April 2024 images.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Processing
    med = s2.median()
    red_q = med.select('B4').reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                                          geometry=roi_q, scale=10,
                                          maxPixels=1e9).get('B4')
    red_b = med.select('B4').reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                                          geometry=roi_b, scale=10,
                                          maxPixels=1e9).get('B4')
    val_q = red_q.getInfo()
    val_b = red_b.getInfo()
    if val_q is None or val_b is None:
        print("Calculation returned None.")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    else:
        print(f"April 2024 images: {n}")
        print(f"Jabal Qidr B4 mean: {val_q:.3f}")
        print(f"Jabal Bayda B4 mean: {val_b:.3f}")
        print("<answer>A</answer>" if val_q < val_b else "<answer>B</answer>")
